title: Proven coset count m=(q-1)/n forces log m not log q -- EVT floor sqrt(2 n log m) != Ramanujan 2 sqrt(n)
reduced_to: The open core is unchanged: prove B = max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| <= C*sqrt(n*log m) (equivalently sqrt(2 n ln m)-cancellation among the m=(q-1)/n Gauss periods chi-bar(b)*tau(chi)). This is the named GaussianEnergyBound / Lam-Leung char-p transfer at r ~ log m = face-3 BGK/Paley wall already in-tree (PaleyFloorBound, GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean). C080 supplies NO new tractable object beyond the already-proven facts it cites.
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley. The EVT 'floor' is a heuristic on m correlated (non-i.i.d.) Gauss periods; converting it to a rigorous upper bound on B needs the full per-period sub-Gaussian MGF = all even moments E_r(mu_n) <= (2r-1)!! n^r up to r ~ log m, i.e. the Lam-Leung char-p / Paley-Graph-Conjecture wall. Identical wall to C063/C064.
evidence: Three exact-integer probes at PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n=2^mu (mu in {3,4,5,6,7}, n a proper subgroup), p=1 mod n prime, beta=log p/log n in [3.5,4.5], n<<sqrt q, MULTIPLE primes per n, true B = exact max over ALL b in F_p (not sampled; magnitudes ~sqrt q via double-prec exp, exact mod-p subgroup arithmetic). Files: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C080_evt_floor_vs_truemax.py, C080_logm_vs_logq.py, C080_floor_breach_and_ramanujan.py. RESULTS: (1) IN-TREE FACTS CONFIRMED: #distinct eta-values = m EXACTLY every config (matches eta_image_card_mul_le); meansq/n -> 1.000 (matches subgroup_gaussSum_secondMoment, per-period variance n). (2) RAMANUJAN FALSE IN REGIME [supports C080, robust]: B/(2 sqrt n) > 1 at EVERY proper-subgroup config (min 1.244), and GROWS with m at fixed n (n=16: 1.39->1.78 as m 258->16387; n=32: 1.70->2.05 as m 4103->20183). So the Alon-Boppana/Ramanujan cap 2 sqrt(n) is genuinely breached and the excess grows with the coset count -- correct structural pin. (3) THE NOVEL EVT-FLOOR CLAIM FAILS QUANTITATIVELY [the attack-plan test 'B/sqrt(2 n log m) -> 1']: measured B/sqrt(2 n ln m) in [0.70,0.92], NEVER ->1, and DRIFTS DOWN with m (n=8: 0.786->0.700; n=16: ~0.83 flat; n=32: 0.83->0.92). The sqrt2 constant is the WRONG null: the complex (Rayleigh) i.i.d. max scale is sqrt(n ln m) with constant 1, and measured C=B/sqrt(n ln m) hugs ~1.12 (mean over 7 configs), NOT sqrt2=1.414. (4) SCALE vs LOG-Q: with m held ~4096 across n=8..128, B/sqrt(n ln m) is bounded with no clean trend (0.96,1.20,1.32,1.16,1.20) = correct O(1) scale; B/sqrt(n ln q) (0.86,1.04,1.11,0.95,0.95) does NOT decisively separate at these sizes (log q = log m + log n, only x16 in n) -- the 'log m not log q' distinction rests on the EXACT in-tree count m=(q-1)/n, not on a numerical separation. (5) Floor never breached (B < sqrt(2 n log m) in all 16 rows) -- but this is an artifact of the slack sqrt2 constant, NOT a proven upper bound.
honest_note: NOT a closure; honest PARTIAL. PROVEN/CONFIRMED (the structural pin, real content): the coset count m=(q-1)/n (axiom-clean eta_image_card_mul_le, confirmed #dist=m exactly) and the per-period variance n (axiom-clean subgroup_gaussSum_secondMoment, confirmed meansq/n->1) are genuine; and 'Ramanujan/Alon-Boppana 2 sqrt(n) is FALSE in the prize regime' is robustly confirmed (B/(2 sqrt n) > 1 everywhere, growing with m) -- so the correct SCALE carries sqrt(log m) over sqrt(n), exactly C080's framing, and the spectral/Ramanujan-upper-bound chase IS a dead end (matches PaleySpectralFloor.lean's own honest verdict). NOT ESTABLISHED (the load-bearing novel leap): the specific EVT floor sqrt(2 n log m) is a HEURISTIC on m periods that are NOT i.i.d. (algebraically constrained, sum-of-squares fixed), so it yields neither a matching law nor a rigorous bound: B/sqrt(2 n log m) stays in [0.70,0.92] and drifts DOWN (no convergence to 1), the sqrt2 constant is wrong (Rayleigh null gives ~1, measured ~1.12), and proving B <= C sqrt(n log m) rigorously is the unchanged open BGK/Paley wall (the EVT->rigor step consumes the open all-moments MGF, identical to C063/C064). So C080 is a CORRECT DESCRIPTIVE FRAMING (right scale, Ramanujan-is-false) built on already-in-tree axiom-clean facts, but its operative EVT-floor target overclaims a sqrt2 constant and a B/floor->1 convergence that the exact probes do not support; it welds back to W-BGK with no new tractable object. Caveats: double-precision complex exp for O(sqrt q) magnitudes (well-conditioned, standard) with exact integer subgroup/mod-p arithmetic; n,p kept small enough for exact max over all b (n in {8..128}, p up to ~1.05e6); the prize p~2^256,n=2^30 behavior of the constant/floor remains EMPIRICAL (the i.i.d. heuristic is the only basis, and it is provably only heuristic). Lean oleans NOT rebuilt (no lock taken); axiom-cleanliness of the three cited theorems read from their in-file #print axioms and sorry-free proofs. No DISPROOF_LOG entry warranted: nothing is refuted (the structural claims are TRUE; only the EVT-floor constant/limit is an unproven heuristic overclaim, already captured as PARTIAL).
